form.label: Microsoft Sysmon for Linux - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Sysmon for Linux XML relay overview for process, network, file, configuration, and DNS query records. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.
